name: Week 14 Legs — Volume Restored, Station-Grouped (Spotlight: Squat + Incline RDL Refresh)
description: Out of the heal week. Sets restored; squat runs the user's W13D5-requested 6/7/8/8 ascending pyramid; sequence re-grouped per the new station-grouping rule (leg press → calf raise on the same machine → Bulgarian → leg curl → incline RDL). Bulgarian split squat steps up from W13 bodyweight intro to light DBs at the sides. Loads held everywhere else.

dayOverview.theme: Volume restored. Squat runs 6/7/8/8 ascending (user's W13D5 wish, 4-set extended). Leg press → calf raise grouped at the same machine (W13D5 station-grouping rule). Bulgarian steps up to light DBs. Spotlights cycle back to squat + incline RDL.

spotlights.why: Cycles back to spotlight. W13D5 set 3 went 'super super deep and felt very good,' and the user explicitly wished the pyramid were ascending (6/7/8) instead of bookended (8/6/8). W14 tests it: 6/7/8/8 (3 ascending + a finisher 8 to restore volume). The spotlight question is whether the depth carries across all sets, not just the last one.

Cycles back to spotlight per the tracker. The hip-hinge cue + dead-slow tempo at 45lb is the durable form drill. After a heal-week sets-cut, the W14 refresh is restored 3-set volume at held load — the cue is the tempo, not the number.

dayOverview.rotationPlan: W10 squat + incline RDL · W11 leg press · W12 seated leg curl + calf raise · W13 Bulgarian split squat (NEW) · W14 squat + incline RDL (current, refresh) · W15 cycle forward — leg press depth or Bulgarian DB step-up.
watchpoints: **Loads HELD at W13** — squat 75/side, leg press 3 plates, calf raise 3 plates, leg curl 90, incline RDL 45. Bulgarian steps from bodyweight/light intro to light DBs at the sides (15-20lb pair) per the W13D5 'happy to go up after this' signal.
**6/7/8/8 squat pyramid test (W13D5 user request)** — 3 ascending sets + 1 finisher set at 8. Watch whether set 3's depth (W13D5 'super super deep') holds across sets 1-2 at the lighter rep counts.
**Station-grouped sequence (W13D5 rule):** leg press → leg-press-calf-raise (same machine) → Bulgarian (bench station) → leg curl → incline RDL. No backtracking to the leg press.

**Bulgarian step-up** — light DBs 15-20lb pair at the sides. W13D5 was clean at bodyweight, user 'happy to go up.' If anything twitches/spasms, drop back to bodyweight and finish — that's the W13D5 prior-attempt lesson.
**QL/psoas watch continues** — cross-leg lateral lean stays in the warmup AND cool-down. If anything talks during warmup, modify the day; if it talks mid-session, drop a set.

sets.name: Warmup (incl. Cross-Leg Lateral Lean — QL/Psoas Release)

exercises.notes: Full depth, slow. Find where the hips are tight and breathe into it. Depth check before loading.

30s each side. Scissor one foot over the other, reach the same-side arm overhead, lean away from the back leg — the stretch runs down the side of the waist into the QL and lateral hip. Do this before loading the squat.
Big slow circles. Wake up the hip stabilizers.
Spine mobility — slow, full ROM each direction.

Standing, knees soft, torso hinged slightly forward. Tight fists with thumbs tucked, rotate the wrists internally and hold the tension. Quick posterior-chain and low-back opener before loading the squat.
Bodyweight. QL check — if anything talks here, modify the day. Also previews the Bulgarian pattern.
Set 1: 45/side x8. Set 2: 65/side x8. Same depth as the working sets.

**LOAD:** 75/side (HELD). 4 sets: **6 / 7 / 8 / 8** — ascending pyramid + finisher.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — testing the W13D5 ascending-pyramid wish:**
- Set 1 at 6: full ROM, super deep. Fewer reps lets you go deeper without fear of overshooting. **This is where the deepest rep should live.**
- Set 2 at 7: same depth, one more rep. The 'build courage' step.
- Set 3 at 8: same depth as set 1, full count. The match-the-depth-from-the-fresh-set test.
- Set 4 at 8: restored volume — finishing 8 (W13D5's 'felt strong' set, repeated).

**Cues:**
- Bar high on the upper traps (NOT the neck), upper-back shelf squeezed
- **Brace like prepping for a punch** — deep belly breath at the top, HOLD through the descent, exhale on the drive up
- **Hips back AND down**, not just down
- 'Spread the floor' — screw the feet into the ground
- Knees track over the toes
- Sit into the bottom
- Drive through the WHOLE foot

**Reflection (the W14 question):** does set 1's depth at 6 reps carry to set 3 at 8 reps, or does fatigue from the ascending ramp shorten depth by set 3? If yes (depth holds), 6/7/8/8 stays the W15 pattern. If set 3 shallows, revert to 8/6/8 or try 6/6/7/8.

sets.name: Leg Press + Calf Raise Station (Same Machine — W13D5 Station-Grouping Rule)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 3 plates/side (HELD). 4 sets of 12. Chase DEPTH, not load.

Full ROM at 3 plates is the work — the deep knee-to-chest position trains the abs/QL (W12D5 + W13D5 confirmed the soreness pattern).

- **Foot position:** shoulder-width, mid-foot on the platform, slight toe-out — set before loading
- **Press through the WHOLE foot** — heels grounded
- **Full ROM** — knee toward the chest, actively pressing to keep the lower back from lifting off the pad
- Slow descent (3s), no bounce at the bottom
- Don't lock out hard at the top — leave a hair of bend
- If the hips lift off the pad at depth, that's too deep — back off
- **Breath:** in on the descent, out on the drive

sets.name: Leg-Press Calf Raise (Same Machine — Stays Right Here)

exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** 3 plates/side (HELD). 3 sets of 15. Stay on the leg press — this is why station-grouping matters.

**Setup:**
- **Balls of both feet on the BOTTOM EDGE of the platform, heels hanging off the edge.** No plate under the foot — the platform edge gives the heel drop on its own.
- **Both feet on the platform** — double-leg

**Cues:**
- **Full stretch at the bottom** — let the heels drop as far below the edge as they'll go
- **Drive to FULL plantarflexion at the top**
- **3-4s eccentric** — the slow descent is the stimulus, not added load
- **1s squeeze at the peak**, no bouncing
- **Breath:** continuous, don't hold

W13D5 'felt easy this time even with slow eccentrics, feel great.' If it still feels easy at slow tempo, the W15 conversation is moving to single-leg + slow (W10D5 trap caveat — only when the eccentric is dialed in).

sets.name: Bulgarian Split Squat (Bench Station — Step Up to Light DBs)

exercises.equipment: bench + light DBs at the sides — Smith machine if free (use smith-machine-bulgarian-split-squat)
exercises.notes:
**LOAD:** Light DBs **15-20lb pair at the sides**, step up from W13D5's bodyweight intro. 3 sets of 8-10 each leg (volume restored from W13's 2 sets). W13D5: 'felt fine no twitching or spawning... happy to go up after this.'

**Cues (carry from W13D5 intro):**
- **Rear foot up on the bench** behind you, laces down or toes tucked
- **Step out far enough that the front shin stays roughly VERTICAL at the bottom** — too short a stance = knee crashes past the toes
- **Front knee tracks over the front foot** — not caving in
- **Lower until the rear knee nearly touches the floor** — controlled, no dropping
- **Drive up through the FRONT HEEL** — the front leg does the work, the rear leg is a kickstand for balance
- **Torso stays TALL** — slight forward lean is fine, no folding over
- **2s descent**, own the bottom

**Watch:** if anything twitches/spasms (W13D5 prior-attempt lesson — going too heavy too fast triggered spasms before), drop to bodyweight for the remaining sets and finish. The DB step-up is conservative for a reason.

**LOAD:** 90 (HELD). 3 sets of 12. Slow tempo — W13D5 'feel these deeply when doing it slowly' is the cue.

**Cues:**
- **Ankles UNDER the pad** — the ankle bone is the contact point, NOT the mid-calf
- **Settings: 5/m/0/1** (verify before loading)
- **Lap pad locked DOWN firmly** — loose pad lets the torso lift and turns it into lower-back work
- **Curl the heels toward the glutes** — full ROM, full squeeze
- **2s eccentric, 1s squeeze**
- Torso stays anchored to the seat, no lifting forward
- No bouncing out of the bottom

**LOAD:** 45lb plate (HELD). 3 sets of 15. Dead slow with a 2s pause at the bottom.

**🔆 SPOTLIGHT — drill the hip-hinge cues, the tempo is the progression:**
- **Pad just below the hip crease** — NOT on the upper thigh, NOT on the stomach
- **Hip hinge** — Romanian deadlift on the 45° bench, NOT a lumbar extension
- Lower back NEUTRAL throughout
- **At the bottom:** stretch in the **hamstrings and glutes**, NOT the lower back. If the lumbar rounds, you're going too deep for current mobility.
- Drive up by squeezing the glutes and hamstrings
- **At the top:** stop at neutral. Past neutral = lumbar load = QL irritation.
- **Tempo: 3s eccentric, 2s pause at the bottom, 1s drive up.** The slow eccentric is the entire reason this lift works.
- Take extra rest between sets if you need it

**Reflection:** at 45lb dead slow for 3 sets restored, where is the stretch landing — hamstrings/glutes (correct) or lower back (too deep / pad placement off)? If lower back, slow down further and check pad position before set 2.

sets.name: Cool-Down — 5 Min Recovery Block (Hip/QL-Biased for Legs Day)

exercises.notes: 30s each side. Scissor the legs, reach overhead, lean away from the back leg — bookend the session with the same QL/psoas release as the warmup.
45s each side. Deep hip-flexor and glute release — the long hold lets the QL and psoas let go.
30s each side. Gentle twist for the QL — draw one knee across the body, opposite arm extended.
60s slow breathing. Knees wide, arms extended forward. Parasympathetic shift.

sets.notes: 5-min recovery block, hip/QL-biased on legs day.

tips: **Volume restored, loads held.** Squat 4 sets, leg press 4, calf raise 3, Bulgarian 3, leg curl 3, incline RDL 3.
**Squat: 6/7/8/8 ascending pyramid at 75** (the W13D5 user request, extended to 4 sets). Set 1 at 6 should be the deepest — see if the depth carries.
**Spotlight: squat + incline RDL** — the W14 refresh of the form-first foundation lifts.

**Station-grouped sequence (W13D5 rule):** warmup → squat → leg press → leg-press-calf-raise (same machine — stay there) → Bulgarian (bench station) → leg curl → incline RDL → cool-down. No backtracking.
**Bulgarian steps up to light DBs at the sides** (15-20lb pair) from W13D5's bodyweight intro. Drop back to bodyweight if anything twitches.
**Cross-leg lateral lean in the warmup AND cool-down** — QL/psoas release.
**Cool-down stays — 5-min block, hip/QL-biased on legs day.**
Rest: 3 min squats, 2 min leg press, 90s calf raise + Bulgarian + isolations.
formPhilosophy: Out of the heal week. Volume restored, loads held. The squat pyramid tests the user's W13D5 ascending preference; the station-grouped sequence implements the W13D5 calf-raise rule; the Bulgarian step-up is the planned next move from W13's clean introduction. Spotlights cycle back to squat + incline RDL — the foundation lifts where form is the long-game progression.
